name: Faviamo Flare wireless tattoo machine
shortDescription: Where performance meets luxury: a wireless tattoo machine with an Mcore-Pro brushless motor, 4.2 mm stroke and a rose-gold, crystal-embellished design.
description:
The Faviamo Flare is more than a tattoo machine – it's a genuine piece of jewellery on your workstation. The crystal-embellished design, built on rose-gold and pink tones, catches the eye from the very first moment, while inside, a motor engineered for serious professional performance does the work.

At just 182 grams and with a slim profile, it offers a comfortable grip even during long sessions, reducing strain on the hand and wrist. The 4.2 mm stroke is an ideal choice for bold lining, saturated colour packing and solid shading alike.

The Mcore-Pro brushless motor delivers smooth, stable operation even under intensive use. Three preset intensity levels let you adapt quickly to different techniques and skin types, while the wireless design gives you complete freedom of movement.

The Flare is made for artists who don't want to choose between looks and performance. A machine that is just as at home in a professional studio as on a premium photo shoot. Elegant, striking, feminine and special – yet a serious working tool in every detail.

features.title: Rose-gold, crystal-embellished design

features.title: Mcore-Pro brushless motor with encoder
features.description: The brushless motor with built-in encoder delivers smooth, stable operation even under intensive use. 10,000 RPM at 12 V, a 31–140 Hz frequency range and a 4–12 V voltage range.

features.title: 4.2 mm stroke, 3 intensity modes
features.description: The 4.2 mm stroke is ideal for bold lining, saturated colour packing and solid shading alike. Three preset levels (P1 Soft, P2 Medium, P3 Hard) help you adapt quickly to the technique and skin type.

features.title: Wireless, built for long sessions
features.description: The 1520 mAh battery gives 4–5 hours of runtime and recharges in about 1 hour via USB Type-C. Alongside the colour digital display and Bluetooth support, the 182-gram ergonomic aluminium housing is easy on the hand and wrist during longer sessions.

faq.question: What is the Faviamo Flare recommended for?
faq.answer: The 4.2 mm stroke is ideal for bold lining, saturated colour packing and solid shading. The three intensity modes (Soft, Medium, Hard) help you tune the machine to the technique and skin type.

faq.question: How long does it last on a single charge?
faq.answer: The 1520 mAh battery provides 4–5 hours of runtime. A full charge via USB Type-C takes about 1 hour.

faq.question: What motor does the machine use?
faq.answer: An Mcore-Pro brushless motor with built-in encoder. It runs at 10,000 RPM at 12 V across a 31–140 Hz frequency range, and delivers smooth, stable operation even under intensive use.

faq.question: Is the machine heavy because of its decorative design?
faq.answer: No – the Flare weighs just 182 grams, and its slim, ergonomic aluminium housing offers a comfortable grip even during long sessions, reducing strain on the hand and wrist.

faq.question: Can I see it in person before buying?
faq.answer: Yes – at our showroom in Érd you can hold the machine in your own hands, by prior appointment.

faq.question: What warranty applies to the machine?
faq.answer: The Faviamo Flare comes with a 1-year warranty. If a repair takes more than 10 working days, we provide a replacement device, subject to availability.

whatsIncluded: Replacement device programme for longer repairs
